title: Tactical plan to stand down the covert organization

tellings.quote: Oh. Oh, yes. It's already been in place for about a year and a half, two years have been.

plain: Steven Greer, who argues that UFO secrets are held by a hidden global group, says a tactical plan to make that secret organisation stand down is already in place. Speaking in 2025, he tells Michels it has been in place for about a year and a half to two years. If true, it would mean someone is actively moving to dismantle the group he says hides the secret.
